metadata.title: That 2 kill spree where I aimed at air and Valorant said ‘Here, take these’ LOL
metadata.description:
Wait, did I just score kills from thin air?
Enemy was probably too busy blinking.
Click if your aim’s a mystery but the kills keep coming!
Valorant logic never quits trolling us.

Tap if your kills also come from pure chaos!

#valorant #luckshot #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts
